title: CTAN: Cycle-Temporal Attention Network for Embodied Audio-Visual Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.17420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Audio-visual embodied navigation equips robots with the capability to infer the locations of sound sources by integrating visual inputs and acoustic information (e.g., depth observations and binaural audio cues). The core challenge lies in establishing effective semantic interactions across heterogeneous modalities (which exhibit distinct feature distributions). Existing feature fusion strategies, however, often rely on simple multimodal aggregation and therefore fail to capture the underlying geometric and semantic relationships, leading to information degradation in complex environments. To overcome these limitations, this work presents the Cycle-Temporal Attention Network (CTAN), a framework designed for active semantic-enhanced fusion (rather than straightforward multimodal combination). translated_title: CTAN：用于具身视听导航的循环-时序注意力网络
translated_abstract: 视听具身导航使机器人能够通过整合视觉输入和声学信息（例如深度观测和双耳音频线索）来推断声源的位置。核心挑战在于在异构模态之间建立有效的语义交互，因为这些模态表现出不同的特征分布。然而，现有的特征融合策略通常依赖于简单的多模态聚合，因此无法捕获潜在的几何和语义关系，导致在复杂环境中出现信息退化。为了克服这些局限性，本工作提出了循环-时序注意力网络，这是一个为主动语义增强融合（而非简单的多模态组合）而设计的框架。具体而言，所提出的视听重建交叉注意力模块采用双向循环一致性约束（在视……
tldr: 提出循环-时序注意力网络CTAN，通过视听重建交叉注意力模块实现主动语义增强融合，克服了异构模态间简单聚合导致的几何与语义关系丢失问题，提升了复杂环境下的具身视听导航性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Cycle-Temporal Attention Network (CTAN), which achieves active semantic-enhanced fusion via an Audio-Visual Reconstruction Cross-Attention module, overcoming the information degradation caused by simple multimodal aggregation and improving embodied audio-visual navigation in complex environments.
